# KnownGDB

> KnownGDB is a curated catalog of canonical video game identities and published artwork.

## Public pages

- [Browse games](https://knowngdb.netlify.app/): Search the published catalog and explore artwork.
- [Developer API](https://knowngdb.netlify.app/developers): Read the consumer API documentation and request a read-only key.

## Public API

- [Health check](https://knowngdb.netlify.app/api/v1/health): Check API availability.
- [Published games](https://knowngdb.netlify.app/api/v1/consumer/games): Read published game identities. A consumer API key is required.
